record.intent: See the system you have built rather than read about it: start the local viewer, let it fetch the graph, and follow one component from the picture into a precise answer about it.

recovery_paths.action: The viewer is running but there is nothing built for it to draw yet. Build the project once, then reload the page — the viewer repaints as builds land, so nothing needs restarting.

steps.expected_outcome: A local address on your own machine, printed and opened in a browser. Nothing is written to the project and the application itself is never run.
steps.purpose: Put the project's shape on screen instead of in your head.

steps.expected_outcome: The viewer answers with the current graph and the reading number it belongs to, so what you are looking at is one settled picture rather than two half-pictures stitched together.
steps.purpose: Have the page ask for the components and the wiring between them, which is what it draws.

steps.expected_outcome: That one component's own account of itself — what it is for, what it promises, and what it depends on — rather than a guess assembled from reading its code.
steps.purpose: Take one component the picture pointed you at and ask the self-model about it directly.
